fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a rented premises near Sevvanthi Garden College Road was allegedly occupied by a person after the lease ended, and the keys were not returned. The matter was brought to Hyderabad North PS on 2025-08-11, while the incident was placed on 2025-08-05 at about 13:05. Tamilarasan Muthu (mobile 9000000260) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned physical documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00098, as the mobile number 9000000260 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Premises allegedly occupied after the lease period ended.
fields.Keywords: illegal occupation, lease dispute, mobile number, documents, suspect, afternoon, college road
